scripts.title: Undetected Noclip
scripts.features: Noclip
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local disabled = {}
local floorY = nil
local floor = Instance.new("Part")
floor.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
floor.Anchored = true
floor.CanQuery = false
floor.CanTouch = false
floor.Transparency = 1
floor.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.RespectCanCollide = true

local function check(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not floorY then
		return
	end
	local cf, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
	local halfHeight = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
	if cf.Position.Y + halfHeight > floorY + 1.5 then
		if part.CanCollide then
			disabled[part] = true
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	elseif disabled[part] then
		disabled[part] = nil
		part.CanCollide = true
	end
end

local function scan()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "ActiveMaps", "Lobby" }) do
		local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if root then
			for _, part in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				check(part)
			end
		end
	end
end

local elapsed = 3
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (root and humanoid) then
		return
	end
	local height = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(height + 30), 0), params)
	floorY = hit and hit.Position.Y or floorY or root.Position.Y - height
	floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, floorY - 0.5, root.Position.Z)
	elapsed = elapsed + dt
	if elapsed >= 3 then
		elapsed = 0
		scan()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Autofarm, Hitbox Expander, AutoChest ESP n More
scripts.features:
After the game fully loads, the script retrieves core services through cloneref and generates a randomized interface name, then hooks the __namecall metamethod to hide that interface from the game's search functions. A background preloader fetches a third‑party UI library and its theme/save add‑ons from a remote repository, while a temporary countdown bar displays loading progress before fading out. The built interface contains four tabs—Main, Shop, Misc, and UI Settings—where the Main tab provides a 1v1 auto farm that automatically positions the player near opponents or teleports to available game pads, an optional auto server hop, a hitbox expander with adjustable size and transparency, and a full ESP suite including through‑wall highlights, jump indicators, 3D box outlines, look tracers, and team‑based colors. The Shop tab automates purchases of knife boxes, gun boxes, and four mythic boxes with a configurable delay, alongside one‑click buy buttons. The Misc tab adds server hopping, anti‑AFK via virtual input, a collect‑all‑easter‑eggs teleporter, adjustable walk speed, and a full flight system with camera‑relative controls and a speed slider. The UI Settings tab allows keybind customization, DPI scaling, notification side selection, custom cursor toggling, and integrates theme and save managers that persist configurations. Additional visual options include adjustable field of view and an X‑ray mode that makes non‑player parts translucent with a slider for opacity. Finally, the script includes cleanup routines that restore original states and destroy all drawing objects when unloaded, ensuring a tidy exit.
